reviewCadence: At every authorization-sensitive route, policy, OpenAPI, tenant-boundary, or data-access change.

commands.name: Core policy regression suite
commands.purpose: Run the fast actor-resource-action matrix, horizontal ownership, vertical role boundary, and step-up policy tests.

commands.name: Authorization regression registry gate
commands.purpose: Fail CI when an authorization regression suite, negative assertion, command, or evidence marker is removed.

suites.name: Actor-resource-action matrix
suites.owasp: Authorization Test Matrix Design, Define the Access Policy Model
suites.pattern: Central machine-readable matrix covering who acts on which workspace resource with which action.
suites.regressionRisk: A new role, action, or target role silently receives broader access than intended.

suites.name: Horizontal escalation and IDOR replay
suites.pattern: Replay object-level actions against resources not owned by the same-privilege actor.
suites.regressionRisk: A member can access or modify another member's resource by guessing its identifier.

suites.name: Vertical escalation role demotion
suites.pattern: Exercise privileged actions with lower-privileged roles and assert explicit denial.
suites.regressionRisk: Admin, member, or viewer roles gain privileged mutation capabilities through refactor drift.

suites.name: Tenant and workspace isolation
suites.pattern: Reject tokens and actors outside their tenant or workspace boundary.
suites.regressionRisk: A cross-tenant or cross-workspace token can access resources because context validation was bypassed.

suites.name: Token scope and session-switching regression
suites.owasp: Automated Testing Framework Integration, Session Switching
suites.pattern: Validate tokens with differing scopes through the same authorization path.
suites.regressionRisk: Tokens bypass missing-scope denial or inherit broader privileges than intended.

suites.name: Contract-driven authorization validation
suites.pattern: Keep public authorization endpoints and decisions verified through tests.
suites.regressionRisk: Route contract changes remove authorization semantics without failing tests.

suites.name: Denied outcome and fail-closed regression
suites.pattern: Assert denied requests fail closed with explicit forbidden or error outcomes, not accidental success.
suites.regressionRisk: A missing authorization branch returns success by default.

suites.name: CI/CD authorization gate
suites.pattern: Run a dedicated authorization regression gate from the root check pipeline.
suites.regressionRisk: Authorization tests become optional local knowledge and stop blocking vulnerable pull requests.
